exposure.description: Embedded outcomes encountered in required AGENTS and mixed legacy documentation; preliminary keyword filters were incomplete. Exposure disclosed; no outcomes used as recommendation evidence. No execution reports or signal-history ledger intentionally opened.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Rank-only success cannot establish advantage over the passive option (§2; L1,L3).
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Gross total-return difference primary economic quantity; dated costs explicit. Preserves investor meaning.
decisions.newRisk: Benchmark/style carry can look like skill.
decisions.beforeV5Outcomes: Yes: exact endpoint and benchmark contract.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: v4 joins mean, rank and classification gates although v3 calls probability descriptive.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Separate expected-return, incremental-prediction, probability and deployability conclusions. Avoid irrelevant vetoes.
decisions.newRisk: Easier cherry-picking unless all statuses reported.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Training mean alone cannot isolate information beyond momentum (L9,L10).
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Freeze matched ladder in §13. Identifies incremental information.
decisions.newRisk: Extra comparisons can become a tournament.
decisions.beforeV5Outcomes: Yes; one primary model, no replacement.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Code invariance to a termination flag does not remove outcome-correlated audit selection.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Symmetric auditing and unconditional denominator; narrow claims if unresolved (§9).
decisions.newRisk: Strict repair can reduce feasible scope.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Total liabilities ≠ interest-bearing debt; OCF/NI changes interpretation around losses. Actual code (§8).
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Rename in future registry; predefine denominator policy and sector comparability.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Current feature count and date depth do not justify an architecture tournament (L9).
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Retain exact Logistic/Ridge/HGB defaults; no third class.
decisions.newRisk: True signal may fall outside these forms.
decisions.beforeV5Outcomes: Yes; conclusions restricted to tested forms.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: A 26-week block is close to 126-session overlap; dependence may extend beyond it.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Horizon-aware 10/52-week primary blocks and 5/26/104-week fixed sensitivities (§11).
decisions.newRisk: Fewer effective blocks; unstable long-block inference.
decisions.beforeV5Outcomes: Yes; synthetic calibration and depth gate.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Current raw-before-derive, endpoint maturity and train-only transforms address concrete leakage routes.
decisions.newRisk: Expanding windows adapt slowly to breaks.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Date weights sum to number of dates; fixed penalty has changing strength as history grows.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Document sum-loss objective explicitly; retain current scaling instead of silently renormalizing.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Bootstrap fitted values do not include all model/source risk or individual payoff dispersion.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Report conditional uncertainty, residual dispersion, numerical failures separately.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Joint annual positivity and classification gates mix questions and can waste power.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Fixed return-relevant stability disclosure/restriction (§11); classification standalone.
decisions.newRisk: Less stringent than inherited omnibus gate.
decisions.beforeV5Outcomes: Yes; explicitly a methodological change, no retrospective upgrade.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Positive volume is not a cash participation estimate (L11).
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Input-only notional/ADV/slippage contract (§12); separate conditional signal evidence.
decisions.newRisk: Assumed costs can still understate stress fills.
decisions.beforeV5Outcomes: Yes for investability, not gross predictive evidence.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Benchmark outperformance may be factor exposure (L1,L2,L10).
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Freeze local factor set, historical-beta residual diagnostic (§14).
decisions.beforeV5Outcomes: Protocol yes; unavailable regional factors BLOCKED.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Microcap evidence and ML papers do not justify universe/model shopping.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Keep universe; new study only with independent feasibility rationale.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: New version names can conceal repeated use of exposed history (L4,L5).
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Full attempt ledger; one v5 run; prospective confirmation (§15).

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Value, capex, shares, macro/flows have specific price, availability or coverage gaps.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: KEEP exclusions where unproven; ADD_LATER only after independent source audit.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: Candidate-date evidence is not a funded, overlapping-position strategy.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: No portfolio/production conclusions; future construction study separately sealed.

decisions.problemAndEvidence: KR accounting source starts later than generic 2013 warmup; mutable repair cannot define a run midstream.
decisions.proposedChangeAndBenefit: Input-only coverage selects start under a frozen rule; hash exact repaired snapshot before labels.
